players.product: AI cloud compute capacity (Colossus and Colossus 2)

quarterly_data.signal: SpaceX's second-quarter 2026 earnings release states it entered into several Cloud Services Agreements totaling $14.1 billion in contracted sales to provide customers with access to compute capacity; the release defines contracted sales as the total value of contracts signed for the non-cancellable, enforceable period. AI solutions & infrastructure revenues were $2,194 million in the three months ended June 30, 2026, versus $475 million in the three months ended March 31, 2026 and $311 million in the three months ended June 30, 2025.
